items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I got a chance to work with this trumpet player named Charlie Creath... It was Charlie Creath; I think we had four pieces.

ctx.x: Well, after I quit the show, Benbow's... I quit Benbow I think it was in St. Louis, Missouri. And I stayed there a while, and I got a chance to work with this trumpet player named Charlie Creath at a place called the Kahoken(?) Roadhouse. That's out...
